items.why: Fear of missing out (FOMO) is hype, not analysis.

items.text: 'This coin will 100× by Friday, my cousin said so'
items.why: Rumors and precise wild predictions are red flags.

items.text: 'Act now, only 3 spots left in this secret fund!'
